content.text: SNIPER: scan - Fast TCP Port Scanner
A fast, multi-threaded TCP port scanner written in Python. It is designed for quick reconnaissance to discover open ports on a target host by attempting to establish a full TCP connection.
This tool requires the [bold cyan]tqdm[/] Python library for its progress bar. You can install it via [dim]`pip install tqdm`[/].

text: [cyan]<HOST>[/]                  (Required) The target host IP address or domain name.
[green]-p, --ports <ports>[/]     Specify ports to scan. Can be a single port [dim](80)[/], a comma-separated list [dim](80,443)[/], or a range [dim](1-1024)[/].
[green]--top-ports[/]           A quick alternative to scan the top 18 most common ports.
[green]-w, --workers <N>[/]     Set the number of concurrent scanning threads (default: 100).
[green]-t, --timeout <SEC>[/]   Set the connection timeout in seconds for each port (default: 0.5).
[green]-b, --banner[/]          Attempt to grab a service banner from open ports by sending a generic HTTP probe.
[green]-o, --output <file>[/]     Save the scan output to a specified file (color codes are removed).
[#] Perform a quick scan on the most common ports of a host
[yellow]scan[/] [cyan]scanme.nmap.org[/] [green]--top-ports[/]
[#] Scan for specific web-related ports on a target
[yellow]scan[/] [cyan]example.com[/] [green]-p 80,443,8080[/]
[#] Scan all ports from 1 to 1024 with banner grabbing and save to a file
[yellow]scan[/] [cyan]192.168.1.1[/] [green]-p 1-1024 -b -o report.txt[/]
[#] Perform a faster scan on a local network using more workers
[#] Scan a slow or firewalled host by increasing the timeout
[yellow]scan[/] [cyan]external-server.com[/] [green]--top-ports -t 2.0[/]
• [bold]Port Specification:[/bold] You must provide ports to scan using either [cyan]-p[/] or [cyan]--top-ports[/].
• [bold]Scan Type:[/bold] This tool performs a TCP Connect scan, which is reliable but easily detectable and can be logged by firewalls.
• [bold]Accuracy:[/bold] A port showing as 'closed' may be blocked by a firewall. Results indicate what is reachable from your location.
• [bold]Banner Grabbing:[/bold] The banner grabbing feature is basic. It may not retrieve a banner from non-HTTP services.
